title: PRISM+ Q65 Ultra 2026 QLED 4K AI Google TV (device R10G, product PRISMPLUS_FFM, made by MOKA)
header:
PRISM+ Q65 Ultra 2026 QLED 4K AI Google TV (device R10G, product PRISMPLUS_FFM, made by MOKA)
Android TV 14 (Google TV), firmware UKR1.251010.001, Realtek RTD2875 SoC, RTD6748 platform

Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/prismplus-q65-ultra-r10g/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/prismplus-q65-ultra-r10g/debloat.txt com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Stock launcher: com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx (pass it to restore.sh, the default is wrong here).
Live TV and inputs: keep com.realtek.dtv and com.realtek.tv.atv (needed for HDMI and the other inputs).

Tested on one set, disabled with pm disable-user --user 0 and lived with for a few days.
Checked over adb on 2026-10-20: HDMI input, ARC audio to a soundbar and Home work. Nothing else verified.
